unverified_hypotheses.hypothesis: A semantic status border and logical continuation indentation improve block recognition during live Reasoning/Tool transitions.
support: NLM theory source recommends status-aware rails and width-aware reflow.
against: The local renderer already has semantic rails, feature-gated rendered-line support, bounded physical-tail wrapping, and continuation-prefix indentation.
unverified_hypotheses.experiment: Use existing narrow CJK/emoji, resize, and held-view regressions; add only the missing direct activation path.

candidates.core: Add plain Space activation for the focused semantic block while the live viewport is held/inspected.
constraints: no second renderer or execution state
risks: Space must not be intercepted in normal input, popup, or non-HOLD states.

recommendation: Accept the bounded HOLD/Inspector Space affordance; reject a second virtualizer and new parser because local reflow and cache primitives already cover those portions.

next_step.value: Ship and verify the Space semantic-toggle route, then retain one Active Note and rerun deterministic gates.

stop_conditions: Do not steal ordinary input Space outside HOLD/Inspector.
Do not claim a deep-research report or import without a task id and direct evidence.
